doc.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01

title: Seventh chords in different positions and getting a good tone
summary: Marrero demonstrates seventh chords up the neck for Allen and stresses fingering right behind the fret for good tone.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
